item.title: Teacher reaches multi-million dollar settlement in lawsuit against school district
item.description: Peter Colombo, who was accused of sexually assaulting a student more than 20 years ago, reached a $3.25 million settlement this month with the Palo Alto Unified School District after he sued for what he claims was the district’s mishandling of the case. item.title: Phil Bobel, Palo Alto’s environmental champion, dies at 77
item.description: Phil Bobel, a Palo Alto resident who championed environmental sustainability and who spearheaded the city’s efforts to prevent creek pollution, reduce single-use plastic bags and adopt advanced technologies to treat organic waste, died on Jan. 31. The post Phil Bobel, Palo Alto’s environmental champion, dies at 77 appeared first on Palo Alto Online.
